scope: These 59 PRs are a non-overlapping audit assignment, not a final feature classification. Mixed combat/tools/acquisition changes retain cross-links. The separate 23-row world supplement only fills Git merge-base evidence.
method: Read only existing MOD Git objects; no network fetch, checkout, official/fork read, PR state change, native test or CI inspection.
actual_merge_base_sha is git merge-base --all(reported_base_sha, head_sha), required to resolve exactly one commit.
Incremental means head-side diff from that actual merge-base; it may contain earlier PRs or unrelated commits and is not automatically author-owned or safe to cherry-pick.
Cumulative branch diff starts at merge-base(fixed main, head), not a two-tree main-to-head diff that can revert newer main work.
Raw files use --no-renames, --no-ext-diff, --no-textconv and full Git blob IDs/modes; content patch SHA256 includes binary patches.
Patch IDs are stable whitespace-normalized comparisons, not behavioral/runtime equivalence. Path overlap is an integration-review signal only.
Central source references and equal bytes are not validation or semantic adoption of the entire original PR.

shared_contracts.service: Captured native equipment and shared semantic ItemFacts; optional read-only current actor/dimension fields.
shared_contracts.kept_policy: TConstruct trait selection, eligible equipment, attribute IDs, formulas and caps.
shared_contracts.remaining: No general attribute-write/refresh lifecycle, persistent actor token, current active-use field in the earlier protection snapshot, or equipment commit authority.

shared_contracts.service: Single provider registry; source catalog facts and scoped lower/upper/additive protection contributions in guarded official hit paths.
shared_contracts.kept_policy: Damage type/tag selection, per-part and max-equipment calculations, signed altitude terms, attacker criteria and modifier budgets.
shared_contracts.remaining: Original StatusFlags extension/minimum/maximum hooks are not migrated by linking this library. TConstruct registration/formulas and each environmental/attacker path require separate source and runtime proof.

shared_contracts.service: Synchronous read-only final raised-item feedback and equipment view before native after_block.
shared_contracts.kept_policy: Shield eligibility, blockade/parrying/blocking values, source durability retention, feedback and ability rules.
shared_contracts.remaining: No replacement of shield wear, sound, disable or caller mutation; the old direct after_block injection cannot remain beside a new adapter without complete-plan review.

shared_contracts.service: Guarded native hurt_armor before/after observation, semantic equipment projection and reusable pure storage primitives.
shared_contracts.remaining: Observation is after native break/refresh, not final per-piece loss interception, mutation permission or rollback. Actual slot/actor authority and local/LAN retention remain unrecovered.

shared_contracts.service: Built-in fluid/player/motion and climbability fact adapters; explicit custom-fluid immersion kernel/view.
shared_contracts.kept_policy: Gravity, jump counts, glide, movement/attack speeds, safe fall and source eligibility.
shared_contracts.remaining: No attribute application, same-frame motion mutation, jump transport/handshake, client prediction or native StatusFlags extension recovery.

shared_contracts.service: Read-only native potion/effect descriptors and immutable caller-chosen per-instance curative policy values.
shared_contracts.kept_policy: Immunity and harmful-duration formulas, ignition/contact timing, milk/default curative choices and application policy.
shared_contracts.remaining: No native EffectInstance attachment, metadata copy/save propagation or same-call Game mutation authority. Unapplied research is excluded from production migration.

shared_contracts.service: Shared read-only item/component facts, crafting product/remainder proposals and borrowed plain-cell count operations.
shared_contracts.kept_policy: Recipes, modifier IDs, ranks, defense/ability slot budgets, extraction/salvage and menu presentation.
shared_contracts.remaining: No automatic station consumption/recipe activation, authoritative live equipment/menu writeback or permission from a proposal value alone.

shared_contracts.service: Generic raw resource layering/tag graph traversal and native source tag facts.
shared_contracts.kept_policy: TConstruct namespaces, damage/source taxonomy, material eligibility and branch-specific cause matching.
shared_contracts.remaining: Exact legacy collectors and consumers must explicitly adopt the service; a common file path or changed tag parser is not semantic equality.

shared_contracts.service: Existing native read-only equipment/damage facts can supply explicit inputs only.
shared_contracts.kept_policy: Bonking draw/charge/release, main-hand attack strength, extra damage and knockback.
shared_contracts.remaining: No generic mutable attack transaction, use-session lifetime, multi-target reentrancy or same-turn commit authority has been proved for this PR.

world_supplement_scope: Adds only merge-base, incremental-path/diff identity and main/central ancestry to the already published 23-PR world ledger at 5f6c20539d7d7740bf559d06de60b52f38f62053. It does not replace its 17 contracts or promote compatibility.
limits: No PR was closed, retargeted, merged or marked ready. No native test/build/CI was run for this audit.
An open PR can already be in main in general, but none of these exact59 heads is an ancestor of fixed main or central. This is ancestry only; equivalent/squashed implementations could still exist.
Stable patch IDs are not a proof of behavioral equivalence, native compatibility or a license to drop a PR.
The actual merge-base delta may include more than the named feature. Every incremental commit is preserved, and ancestry alone is not a semantic dependency contract.
All59 native manifests still declare older official Horizon0c7b5b61; none is certified for selected624c/e8 by this audit.
TConstruct formula/content/acquisition differences remain consumer-owned. Public Pluto observation/projection services do not confer mutation/commit authority.
The v15 proof is complete shared-library plan/apply/type checking, not repaired original armor/combat consumers or live actor/save/LAN/physics proof.
No rejected Horizon fork was read, fetched, edited, or used. Old MOD declarations may be reported only as MOD metadata.
